text: Post claims the stadium roof collapsed during Sunday's final.
evidence_text: League match report confirms the game concluded without structural incidents.
Frame analysis shows compositing edges above the roofline.

text: Photo says a whale was stranded in the city fountain near city hall.
evidence_text: City maintenance logs report no wildlife rescue calls at city hall.
Shadow boundaries around the animal indicate synthetic insertion.

text: Graphic claims fuel tax was removed nationwide effective today.
evidence_text: Finance ministry notice says fuel tax rates remain unchanged this quarter.
The circulated graphic contains a misspelled agency domain.

text: Post says a viral screenshot proves train fares doubled this week.
evidence_text: Transit tariff table shows unchanged fares for the current month.
Typography in the screenshot differs from the official app style.

text: Caption says the singer announced retirement during today's charity concert.
evidence_text: Concert transcript includes no retirement announcement by the singer.
Artist's team posted upcoming tour dates after the concert.

text: Post claims the health agency approved a ban on all dairy products.
evidence_text: Health agency updates mention no nationwide dairy prohibition.
Policy register has no enacted ban matching the claim.

text: Post states the public library extended hours during exam week.
evidence_text: Library website shows extended closing time through exam week.
Campus newsletter repeats the same updated schedule.

text: Story says the new pedestrian bridge connects Harbor Street and Pine Road.
evidence_text: City infrastructure map shows the bridge linking Harbor Street and Pine Road.
Opening ceremony photos confirm the same endpoints.

text: Post states the football club signed defender Luis Ortega on a two-year deal.
evidence_text: Club website announced Luis Ortega's two-year contract.
League registration list includes Ortega under the club roster.

text: Post says this screenshot shows the official tax filing deadline on April 30.
evidence_text: Revenue service portal lists April 30 as filing deadline.
The screenshot text matches the portal wording and format.

text: Post says a local startup opened a new office in Midtown this week.
evidence_text: Company press release confirms Midtown office opening this week.
Business registry added the new office address.

text: Article says the national team will play a friendly in Lisbon next month.
evidence_text: Federation calendar includes a Lisbon friendly next month.
Ticketing partner opened sales for the listed match.
